port.name: Codex
port.description: Living Code for the Codex CLI: native TextMate syntax themes with coordinated Markdown, selections and added/removed diff backgrounds.

guide.installation:
```sh
git clone https://github.com/living-code-theme/codex.git
cd codex
```

```sh
mkdir -p "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/themes"
cp themes/*.tmTheme "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/themes/"
codex -c 'tui.theme="living-code-night"'
```

You can also choose a flavor with `/theme` in the Codex TUI. The picker persists your selection.
guide.configuration: To persist a choice manually, merge `theme = "living-code-night"` into the existing `[tui]` table of `${CODEX_HOME:-~/.codex}/config.toml`. The setting uses the filename stem, not the display name or `.tmTheme` extension. Each theme specifies both `markup.inserted` and `markup.deleted` backgrounds so Codex does not fall back to unrelated diff tints.
guide.compatibility: For Codex CLI versions with custom `.tmTheme` loading and the `/theme` picker. The theme is for the terminal CLI, not the Codex desktop app or VS Code extension. Codex deliberately preserves the host terminal background for ordinary code spans; pair the port with a matching Living Code terminal theme. Theme parsing and syntax scopes are tested; this does not assert that every Codex UI element is themeable.
